statement: A government in a top-3 compute jurisdiction takes equity, a golden share or a formal priority-access security partnership with a top-5 frontier developer (by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolved in 2025. Bloc A: defence-ministry prototype agreements (up to $200M each) with four leading developers and a national AI-for-science mission inviting private partners - security partnerships, but not equity or priority-access terms; government took equity in a domestic chipmaker (not a frontier developer), setting a precedent. Bloc B: local and national state funds repeatedly invested in leading developers (one received state capital from five city governments in 2025), but none is clearly a global top-5 frontier developer.

items.summary: Bloc B set up a national AI industry investment fund (~CNY 60bn) under its state chip-fund structure, creating a vehicle for direct state equity in AI developers.
items.detail: Bloc B's National AI Industry Investment Fund (国家人工智能产业投资基金), registered January 2025 with Big Fund III and Finance Ministry capital; later (2026) invested in DeepSeek with voting rights. Exact registration day approximate; source not directly verified this run.

items.summary: A leading Bloc B developer raised >CNY 1bn led by a city state-owned investment group, the first of a 2025 'state-backed funding spree' (further city funds 13 and 19 March).
items.detail: Zhipu AI: Hangzhou City Investment Group (>CNY 1bn, 3 Mar), Zhuhai Huafa Group (CNY 500M, 13 Mar), Chengdu Hi-Tech Zone (CNY 300M, 19 Mar). Reuters 2025-03-03 and 2025-03-19.

items.summary: Bloc A's defence ministry awarded a top-5 frontier developer a one-year prototype contract (up to $200M) for frontier AI for warfighting and enterprise national-security missions.
items.detail: OpenAI DoD/CDAO contract announced 2025-06-16 (CNBC); 'OpenAI for Government' launched same day. A procurement contract, not equity or priority access.

items.summary: The same Bloc B developer took a further CNY 1bn from a fifth city's state investors while preparing an IPO; state capital from five local governments by mid-2025.
items.detail: Zhipu: Pudong Venture Capital Group and Zhangjiang Group (Shanghai), CNY 1bn, 2025-07-02; Bloc B AI Industry Investment Fund CNY 200M (April). Caixin.

items.summary: Bloc A's defence AI office announced 'partnerships with frontier AI companies': prototype agreements of up to $200M each with four leading developers to adopt frontier AI for national security. Closest 2025 event to a 'security partnership', but non-exclusive and without priority-access or ownership terms.
items.detail: CDAO awards to Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, xAI (Reuters/CNBC/DefenseScoop 2025-07-14; Anthropic two-year OTA with $200M ceiling).

items.summary: Bloc A's government took a ~10% equity stake in a domestic chipmaker by converting grants - precedent for state equity in strategic tech firms, though not a frontier AI developer.
items.detail: Bloc A government ~9.9% stake in Intel (announced 2025-08-22) from CHIPS Act grants. Context only for this indicator; not directly verified this run.

items.summary: Bloc A executive order launched a national AI-for-science mission (compared to the Manhattan Project), directing the energy ministry to build a national AI platform and set up partnership mechanisms with external firms 'possessing advanced AI' capabilities.
items.detail: Executive Order 14363 'Launching the Genesis Mission', signed 2025-11-24, Federal Register 2025-21665 (2025-11-28). Cooperative R&D/user-facility agreements; no equity or priority access. Verified via Federal Register.
